Smolov Jr. is the condensed version of the famous Russian Smolov squat cycle. You squat four days a week, and each day uses a different set-and-rep scheme at a set percentage of your current one-rep max. The volume is high and the weights climb every week, so it pushes strength up fast. It's hard on your legs and recovery, so treat it as a short specialization block, not a forever program. It works for bench press too: just swap the exercise.

This is the base mesocycle from Sergey Smolov's squat program, the part people mean when they say "I ran Smolov."
